In the “Junior” race held at Imber Court a week later, the South London Harriers proved the strongest team and we took third place. Chantler and Martin ran well, with Jordan not far away, but we dropped points in our search for a fourth man.

We then indulged in a race of our own to the next vantage point near Tattenham Corner, when we saw that Patience had moved up to 15th Bill Rice 25th, Ring 27th, Martin 32nd, Webb 45th, and then our handicapper 48th (looking as though he was thinking that it might be easier work with a whistle).

At the end of 2½ miles Chantler was 13th, Martin 15th, Stimpson 17th, and Chantler 23rd. The two first named put in splendid finishes, and Stimpson found an extra bit to split the Aldershot pack, which incidentally enabled us to win by one point.
